This blog introduces Homebrew [https://brew.sh/](https://brew.sh/), a package manager for Mac users. Homebrew uses the Terminal command line.

# Installing Homebrew

Homebrew is very simple to install. You just have to enter the following into Terminal (if you've never used Terminal, just type 'Terminal' in the Mac's search function).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
```
:::
